facts.text: Poured in the My house, my rules, my coffee mug.
facts.why: The sentence is garbled, and the mug in the last shot reads "My House, My Rules, My Coffee!!".
facts.fix: Poured into Harlan's "My House, My Rules, My Coffee" mug.

facts.text: Serve the donut holes when the family arrives at Harlan's house for questioning.
facts.why: The donut speech on the quote page is Blanc's summing up ("a donut hole in the donut's hole"), not the arrival of the family for questioning. The sources do not place a donut moment there.
facts.fix: Serve the donut holes when Blanc explains the hole at the centre of the case.

vibe.verdict: A good-looking family kitchen that nods to the throne of knives and the sweater, but the dishes could be from any New England menu.
missing: Blanc's "a case with a hole in the center, a donut" line
Harlan's mug "My House, My Rules, My Coffee!!" in the last shot
Marta's toxicology report and the burned medical examiner's office
ideas: Swap "New England clam chowder cups" for "Donut hole in a donut", Blanc's case in one dish.

Swap "Buttered lobster rolls" for "Marta's mother's empanadas", since her family is the heart of the plot.
